quota_name: Active metrics with metadata per workspace
description: The number of unique active metrics with metadata per workspace. Note: If the limit is reached, metric sample is recorded, but metadata over the limit is dropped.

The number of unique active series per workspace (up to a maximum of 1.5 billion). A series is active if a sample has been reported in the past 2 hours. Capacity from 2 M to 50 M is automatically adjusted based on the last 30 min of usage.

quota_name: Alert aggregation group size in alert manager definition file
description: The maximum size of an alert aggregation group in alert manager definition file. Each label value combination of group_by would create an aggregation group.
The maximum size of an alert manager definition file, in bytes.

quota_name: Alert payload size in Alert Manager
description: The maximum alert payload size of all Alert Manager alerts per workspace, in bytes. Alert size is dependent on labels and annotations.
The maximum number of concurrent Alert Manager alerts per workspace.
The maximum number of clusters that HA tracker will keep track of for ingested samples per workspace.
Metric sample ingestion rate per workspace per second. The limit is automatically adjusted to be 1/30 of the active series per workspace limit, up to 1,666,666.

quota_name: Inhibition rules in alert manager definition file
description: The maximum number of inhibition rules in alert manager definition file.
The maximum combined size of all labels and label values accepted for a series, in kilobytes.
Number of labels per metric series.
The maximum number of labelset limits that can be created per workspace.
The maximum total number of buckets allowed in a Native Histogram sample. The resolution of a histogram with more buckets will be reduced until the number of buckets is within the limit.
The maximum length accepted for metric metadata, in kilobytes. Metadata refers to Metric Name, Type, Unit and Help Text.
The number of metadata per metric. Note: If the limit is reached, metric sample is recorded, but metadata over the limit is dropped.

quota_name: Native Histogram active series per workspace
description: The number of unique Native Histogram active series per workspace. A series is active if a sample has been reported in the past 2 hours. The limit is automatically adjusted to be 10% of the workspace's active series limit, or the default, whichever is greater.

quota_name: Native Histogram ingestion rate per workspace
description: Native Histogram sample ingestion rate per workspace per second. The limit is automatically adjusted to be 10% of the workspace's ingestion rate limit, or the default, whichever is greater.

quota_name: Nodes in alert manager routing tree
description: The maximum number of nodes in the alert manager routing tree.

quota_name: Number of API operations per region in transactions per second
description: The maximum number of API operations per second per region for all Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus APIs, including workspace CRUD APIs, tagging APIs, rule groups namespace CRUD APIs, and alert manager definition CRUD APIs.

quota_name: Number of GetSeries, GetLabels and GetMetricMetadata API operations per workspace in transactions per second
description: The maximum number of GetSeries, GetLabels and GetMetricMetadata Prometheus-compatible API operations per second per workspace.

quota_name: Number of other Prometheus-compatible API operations per workspace in transactions per second
description: The maximum number of API operations per second per workspace for all other Prometheus-compatible APIs including ListAlerts, ListRules, etc.

quota_name: Number of QueryMetrics API operations per workspace in transactions per second
description: The maximum number of QueryMetrics Prometheus-compatible API operations per second per workspace.

quota_name: Number of RemoteWrite API operations per workspace in transactions per second
description: The maximum number of RemoteWrite Prometheus-compatible API operations per second per workspace.

quota_name: Out of order ingestion rate per workspace
description: Out of order samples ingestion rate per workspace per second. Unless overwritten, the limit is automatically adjusted to be 5% of the ingestion rate per workspace limit.

quota_name: Out of order time window per workspace
description: The maximum time window for out of order samples per workspace, in seconds. The default out-of-order time window when a new workspace is created is 60 seconds, and it can be configured up to a maximum of 600 seconds.
The maximum bytes that can be scanned by a single instant query, in gigabytes.
The maximum bytes that can be scanned per 24-hour interval in a single range query, in gigabytes.
The maximum number of samples that can be scanned per 24-hour interval in a single range query, or a single instant query.
The maximum number of series that can be scanned per 24-hour interval in a single range query, or a single instant query.
The maximum time range of QueryMetrics, GetSeries, and GetLabels APIs.
The maximum request size for ingestion or query, in megabytes.
The minimum rule evaluation interval of a rule group per workspace, in seconds.

quota_name: Rule group namespace definition file size
description: The maximum size of a rule group namespace definition file, in bytes.
The maximum number of rules per workspace.
Maximum number of silences, including expired, active, and pending silences, per workspace.

quota_name: Templates in alert manager definition file
description: The maximum number of templates in the alert manager definition file.
The maximum number of workspaces per region.
